column2: E01. Project-based learning develops deeper understanding than examination-oriented learning.
column3: E02. Traditional written examinations accurately measure a student's knowledge.
column4: E03. Class attendance should be compulsory for all courses.
column5: E04. High-quality online learning can effectively complement classroom teaching.
column6: E05. Students should be encouraged to take courses outside their primary discipline.
column7: E06. Every undergraduate student should participate in at least one research project.
column8: E07. Publishing research before graduation should be encouraged, but not mandatory.
column9: E08. Maintaining academic honesty is more important than obtaining high grades.
column10: E09. Collaborative learning is generally more effective than individual learning.
column11: E10. Universities should prioritize innovation and problem-solving over rote learning.
column12: E11. University curricula should be updated more frequently to match emerging technologies.
column13: E12. Artificial intelligence should be integrated into teaching and personalized learning.
column14: E13. Universities should invest more resources in research than in expanding infrastructure.
column15: E14. Strong collaborations between universities and industry improve student education.
column16: E15. Continuous learning and skill development are essential throughout one's career.
